messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager - Severity P1 - Edge gateway 5xx spike detected for us-west-2. Short window spike at ~08:14 UTC, error rate ~22% (1m) on ingress.gateway.
oncall-elaine: I'm awake and on it. Paging SREs and infra. @kyle @sre-rohit can you join?
kyle: joining. looking at Grafana: `ingress.gateway.errors` jump at 2026-03-15T08:14Z. Top upstreams: proxy-edge-a, proxy-edge-b showing `502` and `504`.
mike: noticed proxy-rule change pushed at 07:55 could be related. rolling back that change now: `deploy rollback ingress-proxy-rules/2026-03-15`
sre-rohit: repro locally against edge VIP -> getting immediate 502 HTML body. Response headers show `x-upstream: upstream-proxy` and `x-envoy-upstream-service-time: 12001` ms. Upstream timeout.
infra-bot: Auto-scaler attempted +2 nodes but hit AZ quota in us-west-2. Quota request submitted to cloud; provisioning stalled.
customer-success-amy: CS reports multiple customer-facing timeouts and webhook failures. Estimated affected customers: ~34 (mix of SaaS and enterprise). Prioritizing enterprise contacts.
oncall-elaine: Mitigation plan (short):
  1) complete rollback of proxy-rule (in progress)
  2) shift portion of traffic to us-east fallback pool
  3) increase envoy upstream timeout to 25s temporarily
  4) pause streaming endpoints to reduce long-held connections
Execute and update chronologically.
kyle: rollback finished at 08:18 UTC. immediate partial improvement: 5xx down from 22% -> 12% but still elevated.
mike: initiating traffic shift: `rb route add --from edge-vip --to edge-fallback-us-east --weight 30` (30% traffic shifted). monitoring.
sre-rohit: pushed envoy config with `upstream_idle_timeout: 25s`, reloading envoy on proxy-edge-a gracefully: `systemctl reload envoy`.
infra-bot: Edge-pool scaled +3 instances in us-west-2 (provisioning). Quota bump approved.
customer-success-amy: Noted webhook retry storms amplifying load. Recommending advisory asking customers to backoff retries for 10m. Drafting message now.
oncall-elaine: Applying temporary circuit-breaker adjustments: reduce `max_connections` to 300 on edge proxies to avoid head-of-line resource exhaustion. Applying change.
metrics-bot: 08:22 UTC snapshot: ingress.gateway.5xx = 9.8% (1m), p95 latency = 420ms, upstream_timeout_count = 812.
kyle: After routing and circuit changes, 5xx trending ~4.2% at 08:27. Still monitoring KV/cache pressure.
sre-rohit: digging logs: a sudden influx of long-lived streaming requests (client: webhook/streams) held upstream threads open and caused upstream timeouts. Quick mitigation: inject header to drop streaming to fallback for 15m: `x-disable-stream: 1`.
oncall-elaine: Customer impact summary: primarily REST/webhook endpoints affected; embeddings and batch inference unaffected. 8 enterprise customers reported user-facing errors, others saw degraded UX.
customer-success-amy: Sent advisory to 8 enterprise contacts at 08:30 UTC: "We're investigating elevated 502/504s in us-west; we've put temporary routing in place and expect improved success rates within 20-30 minutes. Will follow up with RCA."
mike: at 08:33 overall 5xx ~1.6%, upstream_timeouts dropping. Pausing edge rolling deploys for 40 minutes.
oncall-elaine: Post-mitigation actions (owner assignment):
  - kyle: postmortem lead (timeline + blameless RCA)
  - sre-rohit: deep root-cause on streaming holds and upstream thread saturation
  - customer-success-amy: full customer comms summary and impact list
  - infra: review autoscaling/quota escape plan
  - product: review webhook retry guidance and public best-practices
incident-bot: Severity lowered to P2 at 08:40 UTC. :white_check_mark:
oncall-elaine: Acknowledged. Handoff to daytime SREs for 09:00 UTC shift. Keeping runbook open for follow-ups and postmortem notes.
end of thread.
